g.text: GDHUB-84 — curator availability and the first call

text.tspan: five weekly starts at the same hour, from now + FIRST_CALL_MIN_DAYS,
each on the hour, SESSION_MINUTES long, inside hours open for checkpoints,
none overlapping anything booked (calls and consultations); status Open on those days;
sessions show in the Calendar and the call room (GDHUB-70)
the 5 sessions are deleted, the slots free again
Status (Open · Consultations only · Away until a date)
Available hours — one schedule for everything:
periods of days + hours, with or without months,
each open for consultations and/or checkpoints;
a period with months replaces the weekly hours in them,
a shorter one a longer one. At most N consultations a month
Refused: checkpoint calls fall outside the new hours.
A checkpoint is an agreement — move each call
with the author (GDHUB-83, up to CALL_MOVE_DAYS later), then save
Consultations outside the new hours: listed, Cancel each.
Saving is allowed. Cancel shows the message,
unconfirmed for 60 days → not offered for new checkpoints)
Experts with at least one free series,
in one transaction that checks they are free
